title: Rav Bivi bar Avuna or Avina
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Esther Rabbah 2:9, and in Yalkut, Mishlei, remez 959: “Rabbi Bivi bar Avina said: A parable of a guest,” etc. Hyman describes the Ravina bar Avina reading in Vayikra Rabbah 4:3 as a corruption.[^1]

notes.text: Esther Rabbah 2:9 names Rabbi Beiva bar Avuna; Yalkut Shimoni on Proverbs 959 has the abbreviated title and Biva bar Avina; Vayikra Rabbah 4:3 has Ravina bar Avina in the corresponding guest parable. These are the checked digital readings. Hyman’s description of corruption remains his textual judgment; the forms are not merged into one authority identity.
